title: Un-Craftable Minecarts
description: Un-Craftable Minecarts allows you to separate any minecart using your crafting grid or any crafting table.
body:
Un-Craftable Minecarts allows you to **separate** any minecart **using your crafting grid or any crafting table**.

Works for:
- Chest Minecart
- Furnace Minecart
- Hopper Minecart
- TNT Minecart

This DataPack was design for 24w10a (1.20.5) Minecraft snapshot, it will NOT work for previous versions.
However, you can get a fully working versión for 1.20.4 in my [Drive](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1actOlkRz5eBpodsP0Yw4h_8Ag9exvs_6?usp=drive_link).
